_comment: Which YouTube channels graduate from the daily note into a real vault note.
Watch time is the wrong signal on its own: a 3-minute Fireship video is worth a note
and a 40-minute League of Legends stream is not. So aw-youtube-capture.py gates on the
CHANNEL, and uses duration only as a floor to drop accidental plays.
Nothing is lost by not capturing: every video already appears as a one-line entry in the
daily note's '# ActivityWatch Day Log' section, which is generated straight from the same
ActivityWatch data. This file only decides what additionally becomes a note with a
'allow' was seeded from the channels of the notes already in media/videos, i.e. from what
you have actually chosen to keep, plus Y Combinator. 'deny' was seeded from the phone's
own top channels by watch time. Note BaityBait is allowed while BaityPlays and BaityLive
are denied: same creator, different channels, and only the first has notes in the vault.
An unknown channel is neither captured nor silently dropped: the run lists it under 'new
channels seen' so you can move it into allow or deny. That way a new good channel costs
you one edit, and a new gaming channel never floods the vault.
Matching is case-insensitive and ignores accents and punctuation.
